The Swarm enemy (E5) currently has no audio feedback at all. Per GDD §7.3, the Swarm needs coordinated fire sounds (volley burst) and explosion/destruction sounds to give the player clear auditory cues about enemy behaviour.

## Requirements

1. **Destruction sound**: Reuse the existing `playDestructionSound()` function (already plays in `GymFormationScene.explodeRandom()` for all enemies). Swarm should NOT call it in its own `playExplosion()` to avoid double-play. The base scene owns destruction sound.

2. **Swarm burst fire sound**: Create a new `playSwarmBurstSound()` in `src/audio/effects.ts` that plays a single coordinated volley-level sound (buzzing/whoosh) — the entire swarm fires simultaneously, so one sound should represent the whole burst.

3. **Single sound per volley**: Only one burst sound per coordinated volley, not one per entity. The scene (`GymSwarm`) orchestrates this: when new bullets appear in the update loop, play the volley sound exactly once.

4. **Advance audio cue** (removed per operator feedback): Originally requested a ≥ 500 ms warning cue before firing (mirroring Phaser). This was removed in post-playtest feedback — the operator noted the advance cue was "disconnected, not a warning of a shot coming." The fire sound now plays at the exact point of shooting.

5. **Headless test safety**: All new audio functions must degrade to safe no-ops in headless/test environments (return early if `getAudioContext()` is null).

## Implementation Plan

- `src/audio/effects.ts`: Add `playSwarmBurstSound()` (sawtooth + sine oscillators, ~200ms duration)
- `src/entities/Swarm.ts`: Fire sound at point of shooting (single-phase: no advance cue)
- `src/scenes/gym/GymSwarm.ts`: Override `update()` to detect new bullets and play `playSwarmBurstSound()` once per volley
- `src/scenes/gym/GymFormationScene.ts`: No changes needed (base class already handles destruction sound)
- Tests: Update existing Swarm tests for single-phase firing; add volley-level burst sound test with `vi.spyOn`; add headless no-op tests
- Documentation: Update `ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` with audio orchestration details

## Operator Feedback (post-playtest)

- The firing audio was disconnected (advance cue warning) — removed advance cue. Fire sound now plays at the exact point of shooting (scene-level volley sound in GymSwarm.update). 
- Explosion was too quiet — increased playDestructionSound() volume from 0.15 to 0.3.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Destruction sound plays exactly once per destruction — GymFormationScene.explodeRandom() calls playDestructionSound() once; Swarm entity does not self-play, avoiding double-play (volume bumped from 0.15 to 0.3 for audibility).
2. New Swarm burst fire sound exists in src/audio/effects.ts — playSwarmBurstSound() exported.
3. Single volley-level sound per burst — GymSwarm.update() plays once per frame with new bullets; test verifies callCount < formationSwarms.length.
4. No advance cue — fire sound plays at the exact point of shooting; advance-cue state machine removed from Swarm.ts and playSwarmAdvanceCue() removed from effects.ts.
5. All new audio calls degrade to safe no-ops in headless/test environments — effects.ts getAudioContext() guard on all functions.
6. Documentation updated — ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md updated with audio orchestration details.
7. Full project test suite passes — npx vitest run (397 tests, 27 files) at commit a9d8a4e.
8. Explosion audibility — playDestructionSound() volume increased from 0.15 to 0.3.
data.title: Swarm has no audio

# Extend effects module with combat-coupled power-up behaviours

## Summary
Extend `src/powerups/effects.ts` (or create it if not yet present from AH-0MTC0QPS60005MNT) with the four combat-coupled effect implementations. Each effect function receives the scene context and ship reference, manages its own state/timer, and exposes an API for the collision pass to query state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **AC1 - Shield effect (shieldAbsorb):** Returns an effect object with `isActive`, `pop()` method, `apply()` that renders a bubble around the ship, `onHit()` that absorbs one hit and pops, and a timer that expires after 15s. `recollect()` refreshes timer to 15s.
- [ ] **AC2 - Bomb effect (bombClear):** Returns an effect with `apply()` that removes all on-screen enemy bullets (iterates the bullet collection and destroys each), does NOT damage enemy entities. Shows a brief HUD notice string. `recollect()` is a benign no-op.
- [ ] **AC3 - Phase Shift effect (phaseShift):** Returns an effect with `isActive`, `isInvulnerable` flag set to true during active period, `apply()` that renders a ghost outline of the ship, 3s duration timer, `recollect()` refreshes to 3s.
- [ ] **AC4 - Teleport effect (teleport):** Returns an effect with a FIFO stack of remaining uses, `consume()` removes one use and returns true if any remain, `getCount()` returns remaining uses. `apply()` triggers safe-spot resolution (see AC5). On teleport success, grants P6 Phase Shift (3s).
- [ ] **AC5 - Safe-spot resolution (resolveSafeSpot):** A pure function that takes current ship position, travel direction, enemy positions, bullet positions, and safe radius. Returns the nearest safe position along the travel ray (no enemy/bullet within safe radius), clamped to screen bounds. If no safe spot in travel direction, returns nearest on-screen safe position (GDD fallback).
- [ ] **AC6 - Effect factory:** A `createEffect(type, scene, ship)` factory function that dispatches to the correct implementation based on the power-up id.

## Deliverables
- Extended `src/powerups/effects.ts` with shield, bomb, phase shift, teleport, safe-spot, and factory

## Key Files:
- `src/powerups/effects.ts` - add all 4 effect implementations + safe-spot + factory
- `src/core/constants.ts` - reads teleportSafeRadius and flashResetDuration from constants

# GymPowerUpsCombat scene - combat-coupled power-up gym

## Summary
Create `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` - a standalone gym scene that demonstrates P3 Shield, P4 Bomb, P6 Phase Shift, and P7 Teleport against E1 Scout enemies with shooting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **AC1 - Scene registration:** Scene key `GymPowerUpsCombat`, label `PowerUps Combat`, registered in the scene loader, auto-discovered by the gym index, listed alongside other gym scenes.
- [ ] **AC2 - Player ship:** Reuses `src/entities/Player.ts` with standard thrust movement + screen-wrap. No auto-fire (weapon power-ups are out of scope).
- [ ] **AC3 - Scout formation:** V-formation of ~6 E1 Scouts (reusing `src/entities/Scout.ts`), with a SHOOT toggle button that enables aimed fire at the ship live position (parameterising the aim target from the fixed demo target).
- [ ] **AC4 - Round-robin spawner:** Spawns P3 to P4 to P6 to P7 in ascending GDD order, one every 5 seconds, each remaining stationary for a 5-second lifetime. Grow from scale 0 to full in 0.5s, shrink to nothing in 0.5s (delta-time driven, matching non-combat gym constants).
- [ ] **AC5 - 3% collection gate:** Drops are only collectible when their current scale > 3% of full size; collection via overlap with ship; uncollected drops fade with no effect.
- [ ] **AC6 - Effect application:** On collection, the corresponding effect from `src/powerups/effects.ts` is applied: P3 to shield bubble, P4 to bullet clear, P6 to phase shift, P7 to teleport (FIFO). Effects render their visuals and manage their own timers.
- [ ] **AC7 - Hit response (AC8):** Collision with an enemy body or enemy bullet, when no P3 shield or P6 phase shift is active, triggers a flash + brief invulnerability + reposition (no lives, no game over). Values from `src/core/constants.ts`.
- [ ] **AC8 - Hit-check suppression:** During P3 active (absorbing) or P6 active (phase shift), hit checks are suppressed - no flash/reset occurs. P3 consumes one absorption on first hit and pops.
- [ ] **AC9 - HUD reuse:** Attaches the standalone HUD class from AH-0MTC0QPS60005MNT (`src/ui/HUD.ts`) for active-effect icons, names, timers (P3/P6), and counts (P7). No lives counter in this scene.
- [ ] **AC10 - Back button:** Shared `<- INDEX` back button present, navigates to the gym index scene.

## Deliverables
- New `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` scene file
- Parameterised Scout fire target (ship position) - minimal change to `src/entities/Scout.ts` if needed
- HUD attachment in the scene (reusing `src/ui/HUD.ts` unchanged)

## Key Files:
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` - new combat gym scene
- `src/entities/Scout.ts` - parameterise aim target if needed (small change)
- `src/ui/HUD.ts` - reuse unchanged (import only)
